changelog:
- Initial release of solon-development-skill.
- Provides expert guidance for Java application development with the Solon framework (not based on Spring).
- Includes clear rules to avoid mixing Spring concepts, dependencies, and annotations.
- Covers core concepts, web, data, security, remoting, AI, orchestration, cloud-native, testing, and more.
- All examples target Solon version 3.10.0 by default.
- Supports Chinese responses and code comments when the user communicates in Chinese.
summary: Specialized knowledge for developing Java applications with the Solon framework. Covers core concepts, web, data, security, remoting, AI, flow orchestration,...
